items.explanation: Use 有毒 to describe that the oleander has poison. 是毒 treats 毒 as a noun after 是, but this description needs the adjective form 有毒.
灵芝药的夹竹桃 does not say that lingzhi is present. Use 有灵芝 to introduce that there is lingzhi here.
It would be more natural to say 他把它吃完了. 把它 clearly marks 灵芝 as the object that he finished eating.
Use 了 after 写 for this completed past action: 写了.
Use 本 for a book. 个 does not normally collocate with 课文 here.
课文的植物 does not mean “a book about plants.” Use 关于植物的书 for a book whose topic is plants.
